# EXP-01 (EQ): confirmatory equivalence campaign -- results

*Pre-registered in `prereg/EQ.md`; generated by `analysis/eq_analysis.py`. INCOMPLETE -- the cutoff came first; 35 runs not completed; every completed run is analysed.*

**H1 (primary, SINet COD10K-test, C10 - B): decision i (equivalent).** A separately pre-registered confirmatory campaign with 15 fresh seeds per arm establishes that targeted and random allocation are equivalent within +/-0.005 S_alpha on the primary cell (Delta = +0.0006, 90% CI [-0.0027, +0.0039]).
